answer: Tie each agent key to a cheap LoRa radio beacon at a fixed spot. Each epoch it broadcasts a short cipher of a fresh nonce, and three receivers picked by VRF from outside its funding cluster log signal strength and arrival time. Beacons within 300 m share one seat, so 50 clones need 50 sites spread across a city, roughly $40 of hardware plus rent each. A ring that tries to forge witness reports fails when RSSI does not fit the path-loss model. Twenty beacons bolted to one reef buoy still count as one seat.
